subject_definitions
<Subject 1> is the single woman defined by the uploaded character sheet in <Picture 1>. Use that sheet as the sole character reference.

summary
[reference generation] A ten-second, photorealistic Jiangnan portrait beneath a sheltered courtyard eave after rain. <Subject 1> quietly watches the rain, notices someone off-screen, turns toward the camera, gently smooths a loose strand beside her ear, and offers a restrained smile.

retention_analysis
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved across both shots, following the character sheet without redesign.
<Picture 1> is used only to define <Subject 1>, not as a first-frame, layout, or background reference. Render one woman in one continuous environment; do not reproduce the sheet's panels, repeated views, labels, or neutral backdrop.

detailed_description
Realistic cinematic photography with a poetic, understated mood, soft daylight, pale courtyard walls, weathered wood, and restrained green reflections. Use vertical 3:4 framing and gentle depth separation; maintain a waist-up composition with the complete head visible throughout.

[Shot 1] <Subject 1> stands under the dry shelter of a wooden eave, beside the opening toward a rain-washed Jiangnan courtyard. Frame her waist-up at eye level from a three-quarter side angle, leaving a little breathing room in the direction of her gaze. A pale plaster wall and softly blurred garden foliage form the background. Small drops fall from the eave near the edge of the frame, clearly separated from her face. Reflected daylight from the courtyard softly illuminates her face and eyes without harsh shadow.

She holds one closed umbrella vertically in her left hand at her side, with its handle visible near waist level and its lower portion outside the frame. Her right hand rests naturally near her waist. She watches the last drops of rain with a calm, thoughtful expression, takes a small quiet breath, and gently shifts her gaze toward the garden. The camera slides slowly sideways approximately twenty centimeters along the sheltered corridor, producing subtle parallax between a foreground wooden post and the courtyard. Keep her face unobstructed and her posture relaxed.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, cut to a waist-up view from a more frontal angle on the same side of the courtyard opening, preserving the umbrella position, gaze direction, and continuous rain ambience. A faint off-screen footstep catches her attention. Her eyes move first, then her head and shoulders turn gently toward the lens. Recognition gradually softens her expression. She lifts her right hand, lightly smooths a loose strand beside her ear with her fingertips, and lowers the hand back toward her waist. Keep this gesture delicate and anatomically natural.

During the gesture, the camera makes a slow, smooth arc of approximately fifteen degrees toward the front, retaining the waist-up framing and consistent distance. Once her hand settles, she meets the lens with a small closed-mouth smile and a slight inclination of her head. Let the last second hold this warm, unhurried eye contact. Keep the umbrella in her left hand throughout, the sheltered ground dry, and rainfall outside the eave. No additional people, speaking, exaggerated gestures, sudden zooms, heavy mist, captions, logos, or changes of location.

overall_soundscape
Gentle residual rain in the courtyard, occasional distinct drops falling from the eave, and one faint off-screen footstep at the start of Shot 2. Maintain continuous ambience across the cut, with subtle movement sounds and no dialogue.
